title: TraceQA site map
description: site.json, written by `traceqa map` into runs/g_<id>/ next to group.json (a RunGroup of kind site). The pages are ordinary run folders next to the group folder in the same --out folder; each page's runId names one. The map says which components are on which page and which are on every page (the site's chrome). Links come only from the href of link components, and no page is clicked or submitted.

SiteFile.description: site.json. Page addresses have secret parameters replaced, as in components.json.

groupId.description: The group folder's name. Equals the groupId in group.json.

seed.description: The page the crawl started from, as asked for.

origin.description: Scheme, host and port of the seed after redirects. Only pages with this origin are followed.

depth.description: The deepest link level that was asked for. The seed is depth 0.

pages.description: Every page that was read or queued, in the order it was reached (breadth first). A page's index is its position here.

components.description: Every component found on a page that was read, by component id.

shared.description: Ids of the components present on every page that was read successfully, sorted. Empty when fewer than two pages were read. A header or footer whose landmark names change from page to page gets different ids on each page and is not listed.

skipped.description: Links that were found and not followed, one entry per address and reason.

perPattern.description: At most this many addresses are read for one path pattern, where numbers and long hex or UUID segments count as one (/products/{n}).

include.description: The --include globs. Empty means everything on the origin.

exclude.description: The globs that were not followed: the defaults for logout, delete and similar paths, and any --exclude.

status.description: Known values: fetched (rules read and applied), not-found (a 4xx answer: everything allowed), unavailable (a 5xx answer or no answer: everything disallowed, as RFC 9309 says), disabled (--no-robots).

url.description: The address that was asked for.

finalUrl.description: Where the page ended up after redirects. Absent when it was not read.

depth.description: Links followed from the seed to get here.

runId.description: The ordinary run that read the page. Absent when it was not read.

status.description: The run's status (completed, failed, cancelled), or skipped when the page was queued and never read.

componentIds.description: Ids of the components found on the page, in every frame, sorted.

linksOut.description: Indexes of the pages this page links to, sorted.

skipped.description: Why a page was not read or its links not used: max-minutes or cancelled (queued, never read), left-origin (it redirected to another origin; its links and components are not used).

SiteComponent.description: A component and the pages it was found on.

name.description: As in components.json; '*' when the name differs between instances.

SiteSkip.description: A link that was not followed.

url.description: The link, resolved against its page. The query and fragment are left out of web addresses.

reason.description: Known values: scheme (mailto, tel, javascript, data and other non-web links), file (a document, archive, image or media file), other-origin, excluded (matched an exclude glob), not-included (matched no include glob), robots, pattern-limit, max-pages, invalid.
